new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality
new_roles.description:
At GE Appliances, a Haier company, we come together to make “good things, for life.” As the fastest-growing appliance company in the U.S., we’re powered by creators, thinkers and makers who believe that anything is possible and that there’s always a better way. We believe in the power of our people and in giving them the freedom to explore, discover and build good things, together.

 

The GE Appliances philosophy, backed by three simple commitments defines the way we work, invent, create, do business, and serve our communities: *we come together*, *we always look for a better way*, and *we create possibilities*.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must be able to maintain such authorization without current or future employer or school sponsorship. GE Appliances will not sponsor employment-based visas for this position now or in the future.

Interested in joining us on our journey?

 
The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality leads a team supporting the execution of short-term and long term projects focused on product and process quality improvement. The role supports front-line leadership and development of both salary and hourly team members in support of the factory Manufacturing Control Plans. The role is responsible for working cross-functionally to execute the overall goal for reducing the cost of poor quality associated with plant operations and product performance post-sale.

**Position**
------------

Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality

**Location**
------------

USA, Louisville, KY

**How You'll Create Possibilities**
-----------------------------------

* Live, promote and support the Appliance Production System (APS) philosophy and drive continuous improvement in the quality and adjacent areas. Coach all team members to ensure cross-functional, focused collaboration is the way we work.
* Partner with the Quality Improvement Engineering, Business Operations and Manufacturing Engineering Leaders to promote a culture that establishes, sustains and improves product quality through engineering problem solving and discipline around supporting systems. Promote a method-based quick response to new issues.
* Responsible for developing and tracking team performance metrics tied to the overall factory (FPY, EOLA, Scrap) and effect to the product line financial plan (Damage, Scrap). Leads the team to complete projects and tasks supporting this effort. Owns and assigns tasks and establishes accountability at the appropriate level.
* Closely collaborates with the product line Engineering, Field Quality and Service organizations to understand and respond to part or system product level performance issues impacting owner use and satisfaction. Responds to this data in addition to internal data streams (leading indicators) for product quality and reliability (Engineering, EOLA and audit labs).
* Identify and execute projects to improve the cost of operations. Serve as a broad owner for Corrective and Preventative Actions (CAPA), Corrective Action Request (CAR) approach to problem solving.
* Owner of the execution of attributes of the Manufacturing Control Plan for broad areas. Responsible for the training, execution, auditing and improvement of the Manufacturing Quality Control Plan. Support efforts intended to improve workstation documentation process; create, update and maintain Manufacturing Control Instructions (MCI’s), visual aid and alerts (single point lessons) as needed.
* Strong technical aptitude and ability to coach others in complex engineering topics like dimensional control, material properties, failure analysis as well as emerging technologies such as AI
* Support analysis of data as part of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and implementation of responses as required by MCI/MCP. Escalate and measure response to data trends. Validate root cause response for effectiveness.
* Lead and support 1x1 problem solving for quality systems and related issues collaborate cross functionally to improve product quality through the identification and elimination of root cause of issues. Focus on overall repair efficiency.

**What You'll Bring to Our Team**
---------------------------------

* 8+ Years of successful experience in Manufacturing / Quality, focused on providing operational support to support operations and vertical manufacturing operations.
* Demonstrated expertise in a combination of Metrology, CMM or 3D scanning of complicated assemblies
* Ability to work within large cross-functional teams and at multiple levels in the organization.
* Demonstrated excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrated experience as a hands-on problem solver including complex systems (supply, build, testing and diagnosis)
* Demonstrated leadership during technically challenging and complicated cross functional projects/tasks

**Desired Characteristics**

* Engineering degree with strong content tied to understanding and impact to business financial performance
* Quality Leadership experience
* Prior experience in a union environment
* Strong organizational skills- focused on project and resource management

### **Working Conditions**

### 

* Working conditions are normal for a high-volume manufacturing environment.
* Working in this environment will occasionally require the use of safety equipment to include but not limited to: eye safety glasses, hearing protectors, work boots, and hardhats.
* These roles require frequent walking in a manufacturing plant environment.
* Travel (up to 10%) to suppliers and other manufacturing locations as needed.
* This position will be located in Louisville, KY.
* Hours & Weekends: Working off-shift and weekends may be required.

**Our Culture**
---------------

Our work is centered on our People and Culture as reflected in our Zero Distance philosophy and we recognize the importance of reaffirming our commitment to inclusion and diversity (I&D). This underscores our commitment to fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, connected, and empowered to contribute, while positioning our organization to adapt seamlessly to the evolving needs of our workforce and communities. 
 
This reflects our dedication to creating solutions that: Empower colleagues by fostering an environment where all voices are heard, valued, and encouraged to contribute. Strengthen communities where we live and work. Reinforce a culture of belonging, purpose, and engagement. Reflect the diversity of the communities we serve through our workforce, products, and practices. 
 
By further embedding Zero Distance into our People and Culture framework, we will continue to build a deeply connected organization. We are cultivating a culture of engagement, belonging, and connection, because while attracting new talent remains a priority, retention is a cornerstone of our strategy.

GE Appliances is a trust-based organization. It is important we offer our employees the flexibility they need to do their best work while balancing the needs of the business and individuals. When you join GE Appliances, you will have the opportunity to work with your leader to create a flexible work arrangement that balances the needs of the individual, team, and organization.

GE Appliances is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Appliances participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S

*If you are an individual with a disability and need assistance or an accommodation to use our website or to apply, please send an e-mail* *to ask.recruiting@geappliances.com*

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Quality, Fauna
new_roles.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Fauna Robotics is building capable, safe, and delightful robots for everyday life. We are hiring a Senior Manager to lead the quality, test engineering, and reliability organization supporting our robots from development through production. 
In this role, you will improve product and manufacturing quality while building the testing capabilities needed to scale. Your organization will support new product introduction through volume production across our facilities, suppliers, and manufacturing partners. 
You will build the team and its engineering leadership, set the technical direction, and establish quality standards and validation processes. You will turn changing product and manufacturing needs into a roadmap that supports higher production volumes and additional sites. 
The ideal candidate is a technically strong engineering leader who has improved quality and reliability for products where hardware and software must work together. They can evaluate test strategies and guide critical supplier, production, and reliability investigations. They grow engineers and leaders, and make clear decisions on scope and priority while product designs and manufacturing processes are changing. 
 
Key job responsibilities 

* Architect the quality, test engineering, and reliability organization. Assess capability gaps, define the staffing and investment plan, and hire and develop the engineering leaders and teams needed to scale.
* Establish supplier and factory quality teams, with Fauna engineers embedded at manufacturing sites. Strengthen and scale the quality system to support new products and increasing production volumes.
* Define and lead the reliability strategy, working with our engineers to improve robot performance and durability.
* Build and scale reliability labs and test infrastructure to support product development and production growth.
* Scale and develop the manufacturing test engineering team, shaping its structure, growing its leaders, and strengthening its capabilities to support new products and increasing production volumes.
* Deploy and qualify production test systems across our facilities and manufacturing partners. Partner with the software and systems team on automation and traceable results, and improve repeatability, cycle time, and failure diagnosis.
* Partner with engineering and operations to embed quality, reliability, and testability into product design and production readiness.
* Establish quality and reliability metrics and use production, test, and field data to guide priorities and drive sustained improvement.

 
About the team 
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
 
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
 
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
 
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
 
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or a related field
* 10+ years in quality, test engineering, or reliability for complex electromechanical products.
* 5+ years managing multidisciplinary engineering teams, with a track record of building organizations and developing engineers and leaders.
* Experience scaling supplier and manufacturing quality through NPI and production ramp, with strong knowledge of quality systems.
* Technical depth in reliability and manufacturing test engineering, with experience scaling test programs and infrastructure for integrated hardware-software products.
* Strong command of statistical analysis and structured problem-solving, with demonstrated success turning engineering data into product and process improvements.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with robotics or autonomous systems.
* Experience leading engineering managers or distributed teams across multiple manufacturing sites.
* Experience working with contract manufacturers and suppliers globally
* Experience with product safety certification or formal quality management standards.

 
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. 
 
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

new_roles.title: Chief of Staff and Strategic Operations
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**

LTI, a family-owned manufacturer of premium commercial foodservice equipment, is seeking a highly motivated, results-oriented Chief of Staff & Strategic Operations leader to partner directly with the CEO and executive leadership team in driving organizational performance, strategic initiatives, and operational excellence.

This individual will serve as a trusted advisor, strategic business partner, and execution leader responsible for translating company priorities into measurable results. The position will work across all functional areas to strengthen communication, improve business processes, accelerate decision-making, and ensure critical initiatives are completed on time and achieve their intended outcomes.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on impact player who thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, demonstrates exceptional business judgment, takes ownership of results, and holds themselves and others accountable. This individual must balance strategic thinking with tactical execution and possess the leadership maturity to influence executives without relying on direct reporting authority.

As LTI continues to grow, this position will play an important role in scaling the organization, strengthening leadership effectiveness, and building the operational discipline necessary for long-term success.

**Major Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic Planning and Execution**

* Partner with the CEO and executive leadership team to develop, prioritize, and execute company-wide strategic objectives.
* Translate long-term business strategies into actionable plans with clearly defined milestones, responsibilities, deadlines, and performance measures.
* Lead and coordinate high-priority strategic initiatives that span multiple departments.
* Monitor progress against strategic objectives, identify obstacles, and drive corrective actions to ensure timely completion.
* Provide the CEO with objective assessments of organizational performance, emerging risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure strategic initiatives remain aligned with company growth objectives, financial expectations, and organizational capabilities.

**2. Executive Leadership Support and Organizational Alignment**

* Serve as a strategic advisor and trusted business partner to the CEO.
* Function as a force multiplier by improving the effectiveness, focus, and execution capabilities of the executive leadership team.
* Coordinate cross-functional priorities involving Manufacturing, Engineering & Customer Support, Finance, Human Resources, and Business Development & Marketing.
* Facilitate executive leadership meetings, strategic planning sessions, and performance reviews to drive decisions and measurable outcomes.
* Establish clear accountability for decisions, action items, and commitments made by executive leadership.
* Identify organizational barriers, competing priorities, and communication gaps that negatively impact performance.
* Support the CEO in evaluating organizational effectiveness, leadership capacity, and future business needs.

**3. Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement**

* Evaluate company-wide business processes, workflows, and operating practices to identify opportunities for greater efficiency and effectiveness.
* Partner with functional leaders to implement improvements that enhance productivity, quality, customer satisfaction, profitability, and organizational responsiveness.
* Lead cross-functional problem-solving efforts involving complex operational and business challenges.
* Promote disciplined execution, process standardization, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and coordinate resources to resolve issues that impact company performance.
* Support initiatives that improve the scalability of manufacturing operations and supporting business functions.
* Ensuring improvement initiatives produce measurable business results rather than simply generating additional activities or reporting.

**4. Performance Management and Accountability**

* Develop and maintain executive-level scorecards, key performance indicators (KPIs), and strategic initiative tracking systems.
* Establish consistent processes for monitoring progress toward company objectives and departmental commitments.
* Work with executive leaders to identify performance gaps and develop appropriate corrective action plans.
* Provide the CEO and leadership team with timely, accurate, and actionable information to support decision-making.
* Establish disciplined follow-up processes to ensure projects, initiatives, and executive commitments are completed within established deadlines.
* Promote a results-oriented culture that emphasizes ownership, urgency, transparency, and accountability.

**5. Strategic Projects and Change Management**

* Assume direct leadership of high-impact projects assigned by the CEO that require coordination across multiple functions.
* Develop project plans, define deliverables, establish timelines, and coordinate resources necessary for successful execution.
* Lead organizational change initiatives associated with business growth, process improvements, technology implementation, and operational transformation.
* Evaluate project risks, resolve implementation challenges, and communicate progress to executive leadership.
* Manage multiple competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail and consistently meeting deadlines.
* Support the evaluation and implementation of new business systems, technologies, and organizational capabilities.
* Ensure completed projects are successfully transitioned to the appropriate functional leaders for ongoing ownership.

**6. Financial and Business Performance**

* Partner with the CFO and functional executives to understand financial performance, operating results, and business trends.
* Support initiatives designed to improve profitability, productivity, cost management, and return on investment.
* Assist in evaluating business cases, capital investments, resource allocation, and strategic growth opportunities.
* Ensure major strategic initiatives include appropriate financial objectives and measurable business outcomes.
* Monitor performance against established financial and operational targets and help coordinate corrective actions when necessary.
* Maintain a company-wide perspective when evaluating decisions and recommending business priorities.

**7. Leadership Development and Organizational Effectiveness**

* Support the CEO in strengthening executive leadership effectiveness, collaboration, and organizational accountability.
* Identify opportunities to improve leadership processes, decision-making practices, and communication across departments.
* Partner with Human Resources and executive leadership to support succession planning, leadership development, and organizational readiness for growth.
* Encourage a culture of constructive debate, timely decisions, and consistent execution.
* Serve as a positive role model for LTI's core values of **Humble, Hungry, and Smart**.
* Build trust and credibility at all organizational levels, including executive leadership, office personnel, and manufacturing employees.
* Help preserve LTI's family-oriented culture while introducing the structure and discipline necessary to support continued growth.

**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline required; MBA or advanced business degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive business leadership experience, including significant responsibility for operations, strategic planning, organizational performance, or cross-functional business initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience working directly with CEOs, presidents, business owners, or senior executive leadership teams.
* Experience in manufacturing, industrial products, or a similarly complex operational environment strongly preferred.
* Proven track record of leading strategic initiatives, managing complex projects, and delivering measurable business improvements.
* Experience in a growing, privately held, or family-owned business environment preferred.
* Demonstrated understanding of financial statements, business performance metrics, budgeting, and operational profitability.
* Experience implementing performance management systems, operational improvements, or organizational change initiatives.

**Leadership and Professional Competencies**

* **Strategic and Analytical Thinking:** Ability to understand the broader business environment, evaluate complex issues, and translate strategy into actionable priorities.
* **Execution and Results Orientation:** Strong sense of urgency, personal accountability, and demonstrated ability to deliver results within demanding deadlines.
* **Executive Presence and Influence:** Ability to communicate effectively with senior leaders, challenge assumptions constructively, and influence decisions without direct authority.
* **Business and Financial Acumen:** Strong understanding of how operational decisions affect financial performance, customer satisfaction, and long-term business success.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Ability to coordinate multiple departments, build alignment, resolve conflicts, and drive shared objectives.
* **Problem-Solving and Decision-Making:** Ability to quickly assess challenges, identify root causes, evaluate alternatives, and implement practical solutions.
* **Project and Priority Management:** Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively from the production floor to the executive office.
* **Adaptability and Resilience:** Comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where business priorities and demands may change.
* **Integrity and Confidentiality:** Demonstrated sound judgment, professionalism, discretion, and ability to handle sensitive business and personnel information.

**Personal Attributes and Cultural Fit**

The ideal candidate will demonstrate the following characteristics:

* A highly motivated self-starter who takes initiative and requires minimal supervision.
* An impact player who is energized by challenging assignments and opportunities to make a measurable difference.
* A strong work ethic with a willingness to roll up their sleeves and personally drive execution.
* A collaborative leader who values team success over individual recognition.
* A confident but humble professional who can respectfully challenge ideas and accept constructive feedback.
* A proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues rather than waiting for direction.
* A disciplined leader who establishes priorities, follows through on commitments, and consistently meets deadlines.
* A relationship builder who earns trust through credibility, transparency, and demonstrated results.
* A leader who embraces the values and personal accountability expected within a family-owned business.

**Organizational Authority and Scope**

The Chief of Staff & Strategic Operations will report directly to the CEO and work collaboratively with all members of the executive leadership team.

The position will initially operate primarily through cross-functional leadership, executive influence, and authority delegated by the CEO rather than through direct supervision of existing functional departments.

Functional executives will retain accountability for their respective departments, while the Chief of Staff & Strategic Operations will help coordinate company-wide initiatives, facilitate decision-making, and ensure execution of strategic priorities.

The position may assume additional operational responsibilities and direct reports as the organization grows and business needs evolve.

**Measures of Success**

new_roles.title: Senior Director, Automation & New Process Engineering
new_roles.description:
**Job Description:**

**Position Overview**
---------------------

TransMedics is seeking a **Senior Director of Automation and New Process Engineering** to lead a critical transformation within our R&D and Engineering organization. This highly visible leadership position will oversee Automation, New Product Introduction (NPI), and Sustaining Engineering, driving engineering innovation, manufacturing excellence, and operational scalability.

**This is a build role, not a maintain role.**

As TransMedics continues its rapid growth, we need a strategic, hands-on engineering leader who can develop and execute a multi-year transformation roadmap while remaining closely connected to day-to-day manufacturing operations.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in automation and advanced manufacturing with proven experience building high-performing engineering organizations. This leader will drive improvements in product quality, reliability, manufacturing efficiency, and scalability while developing the engineering talent needed to support our continued growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Engineering Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Lead the Automation, New Product Introduction, and Sustaining Engineering organizations.
* Develop and execute a multi-year engineering transformation strategy aligned with business growth.
* Build, mentor, and develop high-performing, multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Establish organizational structures, processes, and capabilities to support long-term scalability.
* Oversee performance management, professional development, and engineering resource planning.

**Automation & Advanced Manufacturing**

* Drive the implementation of advanced automation, robotics, and innovative manufacturing technologies.
* Lead automation initiatives across multiple manufacturing lines to improve quality, efficiency, and throughput.
* Identify opportunities to modernize manufacturing processes, systems, and infrastructure.
* Establish scalable, reliable, and cost-effective manufacturing solutions.

**New Product Introduction & Sustaining Engineering**

* Provide strategic leadership for NPI engineering and manufacturing process development.
* Ensure successful transitions from product development into scalable manufacturing.
* Lead sustaining engineering initiatives to improve existing products and manufacturing processes.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical challenges and support product launches.
* Maintain a hands-on approach to troubleshooting manufacturing issues and addressing production or launch risks.

**Design for Excellence (DfX)**

* Champion Design for Excellence (DfX), including Design for Manufacturability (DFM), throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Drive product and process simplification, including part-count reduction.
* Improve product reliability, manufacturing efficiency, and cost effectiveness through engineering design improvements.
* Establish best practices supporting consistent, scalable manufacturing performance.

**Strategic Collaboration & Operational Excellence**

* Partner closely with R&D, Quality, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement in engineering systems, processes, and infrastructure.
* Leverage manufacturing technologies, digital tools, and operational data to improve engineering outcomes.
* Support capital planning, resource allocation, and strategic investment decisions.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience specifying, developing, and implementing automation across multiple manufacturing lines.
* Strong technical understanding of manufacturing processes, automation technologies, and engineering operations.
* Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on technical problem-solving.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA or advanced degree.
* Proven success leading multidisciplinary engineering organizations through significant growth or transformation.
* Experience implementing advanced manufacturing technologies, including robotics and automated production systems.
* Strong understanding of Design for Excellence (DfX) and Design for Manufacturability (DFM).
* Knowledge of regulatory frameworks, quality systems, and compliance requirements.
* Experience leveraging Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and digital manufacturing technologies.
* Demonstrated financial acumen, capital planning, project management, and resource allocation experience.
* Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent.

**Work Environment**
--------------------

This position operates in both office and manufacturing floor environments and requires a leader who is comfortable engaging directly with engineering teams, manufacturing operations, and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

TransMedics is committed to equitable and transparent compensation.

The expected base salary range for this position is **$220,600 – $314,050 annually**, representing the company's current good-faith estimate of compensation.

Actual compensation will depend on factors including candidate experience, qualifications, skills, and specific work location.

This position may also be eligible for:

* Performance-based bonuses
* Equity compensation
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Retirement savings benefits
* Paid time off
* Wellness resources

TransMedics complies with all applicable U.S. pay transparency laws and does not request or consider salary history.

**About TransMedics**
---------------------

TransMedics is transforming organ transplantation through innovative technologies designed to improve the availability, utilization, and outcomes of donor organs.

Our mission is to help save more lives by advancing the science and technology of organ preservation and transplantation.

Join a growing organization where engineering innovation, technical excellence, and meaningful impact come together to advance life-saving technology.

This is a full-time, **on-site position** currently based at TransMedics' facility in Andover, MA.

TransMedics is preparing to transition operations to a new facility in **Somerville, MA**. Candidates should be aware of this upcoming move and must be willing and able to work on-site at both locations as the transition occurs.

Candidates must currently reside within commuting distance of the work location or be willing to relocate to the Greater Boston area.

This position requires regular collaboration with engineering, manufacturing, and cross-functional teams, including direct engagement on the manufacturing floor.

TransMedics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

TransMedics is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and hiring process.

We value the unique perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences of our employees and believe that an inclusive workforce strengthens our ability to innovate and fulfill our mission of saving lives.

**Employee Benefit:**

Medical with Health Reimbursement Account through Blue Cross/Blue Shield of MA

Dental

Vision

Healthcare Flexible Spending Account

Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account

Short Term Disability

Long Term Disability

401K Plan

Pet insurance

Employee Stock Purchase Plan

TransMedics is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, marital status, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

new_roles.title: Director, Program Operations
new_roles.description:
In this role, the Director of Program Operations leads a team of Operations Program Managers (OPM) and Material Program Managers (MPM) responsible for the operational elements of program execution within Mercury's Processing Technologies business unit. This role serves as the primary conduit between the line of business and operational teams, ensuring seamless coordination across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and growth functions.

You will be responsible for developing and executing operational program plans for critical programs, overall ownership of operational program performance, and internal communication of customer requirements affecting operational execution.

The Director of Program Operations will support proposals by providing accurate basis of cost estimates, focusing on supply chain material costs in addition to manufacturing labor costs. This work will be performed in conjunction with factory operations, supply chain, and engineering functions. Candidates must have excellent written and oral communications skills to influence across multiple functions and communicate effectively with external partners.

This role is on site at one of the following Mercury facilities: **Hudson NH, Phoenix AZ**

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of OPMs and MPMs accountable for operational aspects of program life cycle from proposal, development, production, sustainment, & delivery.
* Serve as the primary liaison between the line of business and operations, communicating customer requirements that affect manufacturing and supply chain execution.
* Responsible for meeting the financial objectives of the business unit, including the management of Estimate at Completion (EACs) specific to operations labor and material content.
* Oversee supply chain and manufacturing milestones to ensure compliance with contract baseline.
* Monitor program risks and opportunities, including obsolescence management, reporting, and improvement actions.
* Support and present operations metrics and data through program reviews (both internal and external) to Mercury and customer leadership.
* Champion efforts to meet readiness requirements throughout an NPI stage-gate process.
* Change leader, helping to drive Mercury's strategy, structure, and values.
* Strategic thinking coupled with ROI / business case development.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree
* Typically requires 10+ years prior relevant experience in functional areas of Supply Chain, Operations (including Production Control), Program Management, or technical Project Management.
* Strong financial acumen with experience providing input into and reviewing EACs, along with development of business cases.
* Experience in review and understanding of Statements of Work (SOW) and project requirements (technical and commercial).
* Strong analytical skills, problem‑solving capabilities, and attention to detail.
* Experience developing and mentoring high‑performing teams.
* Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation), leadership abilities, and the ability to work in an IPT environment.
* The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* A self-starter, capable of achieving organizational and program objectives, and able to interface with all levels of internal management and external stakeholders.
* Ability to succeed in fast paced, developmental environment.
* Excellent time management skills and the ability to assign the appropriate priorities to the many tasks that need to be performed.
* Knowledge of US Government acquisition laws and regulations (FAR).
* Proficiency in ERP/MRP business systems.
* Knowledge of Mercury-type products.

new_roles.description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world.A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

**Job Summary**
---------------





**General Purpose** **:**

Responsible for leading and developing a team of process engineers and technicians responsible for SMT manufacturing processes and continuous improvement. Provides technical and organizational leadership to establish and improve manufacturing process capabilities, increase capacity and throughput, reduce cost, improve quality and reliability, and support successful introduction of new products. Partners closely with Operations, Quality, Product Engineering, NPI, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and other functional teams to ensure manufacturing processes meet customer, quality, delivery, cost, and capacity requirements.

**Principal Accountabilities** **:**

* Lead, coach, develop, and manage a team of process engineers and technicians supporting SMT manufacturing, including board printing, SPI, pick and place, reflow, AOI, X-ray, and other back-end operations, excluding Box Assembly.

* Establish clear goals, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans for engineering team members. Provide regular coaching, feedback, performance management, and career development.

* Establish, maintain, and continuously improve process capabilities to achieve required levels of quality, reliability, throughput, capacity, and cost.

* Develop and maintain process documentation, including work instructions, PFMEA, Control Plans, process specifications, and other applicable manufacturing documentation.

* Lead engineering efforts to identify and eliminate process variation, defects, scrap, rework, downtime, and other sources of manufacturing inefficiency.

* Use data-driven problem-solving and appropriate engineering methodologies, including statistical analysis, SPC, DOE, root-cause analysis, and structured corrective action, to resolve complex manufacturing issues.

* Develop and maintain appropriate engineering and manufacturing performance metrics.

OEE, scrap, and yield to name a few

* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, collaboration, problem solving, and ownership within the engineering organization.

* Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, tools, standards, and best practices and share lessons learned across the organization.

* Ensure engineering activities comply with applicable safety, environmental, quality-system, regulatory, customer, and company requirements.

* Build effective relationships with internal and external customers, suppliers, equipment manufacturers, and other technical partners as required.

* Communicate engineering priorities, project status, risks, resource requirements, and recommendations effectively to site and senior leadership.

* Implement appropriate HR strategies and actions to recruit, retain, develop, and motivate a qualified and high-performing engineering workforce.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

**EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE:**

Requires a bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience and training. A Master's or MBA degree is a plus but not required.

Typically requires **9 years** of engineering experience, including experience leading or supervising engineering personnel. Experience in high-volume electronics manufacturing and SMT processes is strongly preferred.

 

**KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / ABILITIES:**

* Demonstrated functional, technical, and people-management skills, with the ability to lead engineers and technicians in a manufacturing environment.

* Strong knowledge of SMT manufacturing processes, including solder paste printing, SPI, pick and place, reflow, AOI, X-ray, and related manufacturing processes.

* Demonstrated understanding of process capability, statistical process control, root-cause analysis, DOE, PFMEA, Control Plans, and structured continuous improvement methodologies.

* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence decisions across Engineering, Operations, Quality, NPI, Product Engineering, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and other functions.

* Ability to establish priorities, allocate resources, manage competing projects, and make sound engineering and business decisions.

* Demonstrated ability to use manufacturing and engineering data to identify problems, establish facts, determine root causes, and drive measurable improvements.

* Strong understanding of manufacturing economics, including cost reduction, capacity, throughput, capital investment, and return on investment.

* Demonstrated ability to develop, coach, and retain engineering talent and build a high-performing team.

* Strong interpersonal, communication, presentation, and organizational skills.

* Ability to communicate complex technical information effectively to engineers, technicians, operations personnel, customers, and senior management.

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex technical, engineering, financial, and business documents.

* Ability to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries and complaints and resolve complex issues using sound judgment and appropriate communication.

* Ability to make effective and persuasive presentations regarding technical recommendations, business cases, project status, and complex engineering issues.

* Ability to work with mathematical concepts including probability, statistical inference, process capability, and statistical analysis and apply them to practical manufacturing situations.

* Ability to define problems, collect and analyze data, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, and develop practical solutions.

* Demonstrated proficiency with common engineering and business software, including word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, data analysis, and other applicable manufacturing/engineering systems.

* Working knowledge of applicable employment laws, company policies, and HR practices.

 

JT05

AA01

LB34

 
 

**What you'll receive for the great work you provide:**

* Full range of medical, dental, and vision plans
* Life Insurance
* Short-term and Long-term Disability
* Matching 401(k) Contributions
* Vacation and Paid Sick Time
* Tuition Reimbursement

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Production Planning & Logistics – Development Programs (R5252)
new_roles.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

### **Job Description:**

Shield AI is seeking a highly driven Sr. Manager Materials Planning & Logistics to lead supply planning, material readiness, production planning, and logistics execution for next-generation autonomous aircraft development programs and a new greenfield manufacturing facility. This leadership role is accountable for establishing the people, processes, systems, and infrastructure required to support rapid product development, new product introduction, and the transition to scalable rate production.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational leadership with hands-on execution, thrives in fast-paced environments, and has experience building manufacturing and supply chain capabilities from the ground up. You will work cross-functionally with Engineering, Program Management, Quality, Procurement, and Operations teams.

**What you'll do:**

Development Program Materials Planning

* Own the materials planning, production control, inventory, warehousing, and logistics strategy.
* Partner with Engineering, Program Management, and Procurement to develop and maintain accurate build plans that are aligned with program milestones.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators for schedule attainment, material availability, shortage reduction, inventory health, work-order execution, and planning accuracy.
* Identify long-lead material risks and implement mitigation strategies to protect schedule.
* Oversee the development and execution of material recovery plans.
* Drive engineering change management processes to support rapid development and ECO implementation.
* Develop planning models that support rapid prototyping, design iteration, and low-rate initial production activities.
* Support executive-level program and operations reviews by clearly communicating material status, risks, business impacts, and required decisions.

Greenfield Facility Build & Operational Readiness

* Lead planning and logistics readiness activities for a new manufacturing facility.
* Design and implement warehouse, stockroom, and material flow processes from receiving through point-of-use consumption.
* Establish inventory control procedures, material storage standards, and transaction discipline.
* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and Facilities teams to optimize material movement and operational efficiency.

Team Leadership

* Create a culture focused on accountability, operational excellence, continuous improvement, and mission execution.
* Establish standard work and training programs.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration to solve complex challenges.

**Required qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 7+ years of experience in materials planning, inventory management, or supply chain operations.
* Experience supporting complex hardware development programs in aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or advanced manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience implementing or scaling material planning and inventory management processes.
* Strong understanding of MRP/ERP systems and supply chain planning methodologies.
* Experience managing material readiness for new product introduction (NPI) and engineering development programs.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly dynamic environment with evolving priorities.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain/maintain a security clearance

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience supporting greenfield manufacturing facility launches or major facility expansions.
* Aerospace, defense, unmanned systems, or advanced technology manufacturing experience.
* Experience with Oracle, SAP, Costpoint, or similar ERP platforms.
* APICS/ASCM certifications (CPIM, CSCP) or equivalent.
* Familiarity with ITAR, EAR, DFARS, and government contracting requirements.
* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or operational excellence experience.
* Experience supporting production ramp and transition from development to rate manufacturing.

**Why Shield AI:**

At Shield AI, you'll help build technology that matters. You'll work alongside world-class engineers, operators, and innovators solving some of the most challenging problems in autonomy and national security. This is a unique opportunity to shape the foundation of a rapidly growing aerospace and defense company while helping bring revolutionary autonomous systems into operational service.

new_roles.title: Director of Operational Excellence and Implementation (REMOTE)
new_roles.description:
**Job Summary:** 
 
The **Director of Operational Excellence and Implementation** provides strategic leadership and execution support for priority operational initiatives in partnership with the Chief Operating Officer and Operations leaders. This role translates organizational priorities into actionable implementation plans, leads assigned cross-functional initiatives, improves operational processes, and drives sustainable improvements in how work is performed.

The Director leads efforts to move initiatives from strategy through execution by developing implementation plans, establishing timelines and accountability, coordinating cross-functional activities, identifying risks and barriers, measuring progress, and providing clear visibility to leadership. The role also partners with teams to evaluate and redesign processes, strengthen procedures and documentation, improve cross-training and operational continuity, and identify opportunities to enhance efficiency through technology, automation, and self-service.

This role requires demonstrated experience leading operational improvement initiatives, managing complex projects, influencing across teams, and successfully implementing change. Success in this role requires strong strategic thinking, project execution, problem-solving, communication, and relationship-building skills, along with the ability to drive accountability and deliver measurable results.

This role follows a hybrid work arrangement, with the majority of time worked remotely and periodic in-office requirements in our downtown Chicago office.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Implementation and Project Coordination** **(40%)**

* **Develop and maintain implementation plans, timelines, milestones, responsibilities, and action items for priority Operations initiatives.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coordinate activities across teams and follow up on commitments, deliverables, and outstanding actions.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Track project progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and issues requiring leadership attention.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Prepare concise status updates and other progress reporting for the COO and appropriate leaders.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Lead assigned cross-functional Operations initiatives from planning through implementation, working with department leaders to establish accountability, resolve barriers, and deliver agreed upon outcomes.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Facilitate working sessions to clarify responsibilities, resolve implementation issues, and move work from discussion to action.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Partner with Operations leaders to advance agreed priorities, clarify responsibilities, and strengthen accountability while maintaining departmental ownership of ongoing operations.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Process Improvement (30%)**

* **Review and document selected operational processes and workflows.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Work with staff to identify unnecessary steps, manual work, duplication, unclear handoffs, and other opportunities for improvement.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Develop practical recommendations to simplify workflows, improve consistency, and strengthen operational effectiveness.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Lead assigned process improvement initiatives in partnership with department leaders, including implementation and evaluation of results.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help develop and maintain standard operating procedures and other operational documentation.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthen cross-training and backup coverage for critical processes.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identify appropriate opportunities to improve workflows through technology, automation, and self-service.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Operational Change and Coordination (20%)**

* **Lead or coordinate implementation of assigned process, technology, and organizational changes within Operations, in partnership with the responsible department leaders.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coordinate operational activities associated with selected technology implementations and other modernization initiatives.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help ensure changes are supported by appropriate documentation, communications, training, and follow-up.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Bring together the appropriate staff and leaders when work crosses departmental boundaries.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help clarify responsibilities and handoffs when ownership is unclear.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identify implementation barriers and work with the appropriate leaders to resolve or escalate them.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Monitor recently implemented changes and help address issues affecting adoption or effectiveness.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Measurement and Reporting (10%)**

* **Establish practical measures for selected initiatives and operational improvements.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Develop baseline information when needed to evaluate the impact of a change.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Monitor whether implemented changes are achieving expected results.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Use available operational data and staff or candidate feedback to identify areas requiring additional attention.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Provide the COO with clear visibility into progress, risks, workload, and outstanding decisions.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Initial Focus Areas:**

*(Initial assignments are expected to include)*

* **Supporting implementation of priority Operations initiatives within DANB’s strategic roadmap.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Establishing a consistent approach for planning, tracking, and reporting major Operations projects.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Supporting process improvement in selected candidate-facing areas, including Document Review, Client Services, and Certification Operations.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identifying opportunities to reduce manual work and improve workflows through process redesign and technology.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthening procedures, documentation, cross-training, and backup coverage.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Supporting implementation of approved changes to Operations roles, responsibilities, and processes.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Skills and Attributes:**

* **Strong organizational and project implementation skills with consistent attention to follow-through.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Ability to organize complex work into clear plans, responsibilities, timelines, and next steps.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.**
 --------------------------------------------------------
* **Effective facilitator who can help teams move from discussion to decisions and action.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong written and verbal communication skills.**
 ---------------------------------------------------
* **Collaborative and skilled at building productive relationships across teams and functions.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Able to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and recognize when issues require escalation.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Demonstrated ability to influence leaders and teams, establish accountability, and drive initiatives to completion without direct supervisory authority.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Practical approach to process improvement that avoids unnecessary complexity or bureaucracy.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Comfortable learning new systems, technologies, and operational processes.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Education & Qualifications:**

* **Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience required.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Minimum 8 years of progressively responsible experience in operations, project implementation, process improvement, or business operations, including demonstrated responsibility for leading complex, cross-functional initiatives required.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Demonstrated success leading initiatives from planning through implementation, including delivering measurable operational improvements.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience reviewing and improving business processes and workflows.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience supporting technology-enabled operational change preferred.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience in certification, credentialing, assessment, associations, nonprofits, healthcare, or another regulated environment is preferred.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Physical Demands:**

Required to sit for extended periods of time; may need to walk or stand in the course of work as well as light (20-30 lbs.) to medium (30-40 lbs.) levels of lifting of supplies and/or equipment.

**Work Environment:**

Work performed in an office environment, either onsite or offsite; periodic travel to be expected (<10%)

new_roles.title: Director - Corporate Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
**Description**

#### **Position Summary**

The Director of Corporate Continuous Improvement (CI) leads MacAllister's enterprise CI strategy, Corporate CI team, and improvement portfolio. In partnership with the owner, executive team, and divisional leaders, the Director helps establish and build alignment around MacAllister's CI vision, strategy, priorities, and multi-year roadmap. The Director identifies and prioritizes high-value opportunities, builds organizational problem-solving capability, and leads improvement work from opportunity identification through execution and sustainment.

The role establishes CI standards, tools, and training; coaches, mentors, and influences leaders and teams across the organization; and communicates CI priorities, results, and opportunities for support.

The ultimate objective is to build and sustain a culture in which continuous improvement becomes habitual and is reflected in how leaders and employees think, act, solve problems, and improve the way work gets done.

#### **Position Duties/Responsibilities**

Primary Responsibilities:

* Partner with the executive team, and divisional leaders to develop and maintain MacAllister's CI strategy, multi-year roadmap, priorities, and operating model aligned with company goals. Build leadership alignment and shared ownership of CI priorities and expectations across the organization.
* Own CI project identification, prioritization, approval, execution, and close-out, focusing on where CI creates the most value; support employee-driven improvement alongside leader-sponsored initiatives.
* Maintain consistent project close-out documenting results, lessons learned, and sustainment plans; verify improvements and results are sustained and take corrective action as needed.
* Set organization-wide CI standards, tools, and terminology; guide Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, DMAIC, and PDCA application grounded in facts, data, and root cause analysis; coach project teams and facilitate select high-impact improvement events.
* Lead improvement-related change management, engaging affected employees early and ensuring process adoption and sustainment.
* Oversee CI training tailored to responsibility levels using consistent terminology and live projects; coach and support CI-trained departmental leaders who remain in their home departments outside CI.
* Define CI value primarily through capability measures-leaders solving problems independently, AI use cases adopted, and idea-to-approval cycle time-with financial results as supporting evidence.
* Communicate CI initiatives, results, and available support so leaders know when and how to engage the team; share success stories and recognize improvement contributors.
* Use coaching-first leadership to build team autonomy, confidence, and influence; foster problem reporting, experimentation, and learning from mistakes by supporting people publicly and coaching privately.
* Hire, develop, and manage CI personnel; oversee budget, resource allocation, and team structure as needs evolve.
* Play a leadership role in MacAllister's Center of Practice for CI, AI, and problem-solving leadership, incorporating AI and other emerging technologies into CI methods where they improve problem solving, decision making, or productivity. Partner with MacAllister's enterprise AI leadership on broader AI strategy, standards, and adoption.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

* Directly supervises the Corporate CI team and oversees day-to-day operations of the CI department. Mentors and coaches CI team members to strengthen their capabilities as problem solvers, facilitators, coaches, and trusted business partners.
* Reviews and evaluates the work and performance of reporting employees; has authority for hiring and disciplinary actions.

#### **Position Requirements**

Required:

* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, or a related field.
* 10 years or more of experience in continuous improvement, operations, or business transformation.
* 5 years or more of experience leading leaders.
* Proven success coaching others to identify and solve problems independently.
* Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, DMAIC, and PDCA.
* A valid driver's license.

Preferred:

* Master's degree in business or a related discipline.
* Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt or equivalent depth of experience designing and delivering CI training.
* Experience at a Caterpillar dealership or in the equipment sales, service, or rental industry.
* Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to learn and apply emerging technologies, including AI, to strengthen problem solving, process improvement, decision support, and organizational productivity. Experience applying AI in these areas is preferred but not required.
* Experience building on an existing CI function and growing its influence across a multi-location organization.

#### **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong coaching and leadership development skills; leads through influence rather than authority.
* Ability to connect improvement work to business priorities and help leaders choose where to focus.
* Curiosity about and practical comfort with AI as a business tool.
* Exceptional communication and facilitation skills with all levels, from the front line to executives.
* Ability to build and maintain trusted relationships with executives, senior managers, and teams.
* Respect for existing culture and relationships, with the judgment to improve without unnecessary disruption.
* Strong organizational, prioritization, and project management skills.
* Effective computer skills with Microsoft Office and the ability to learn proprietary systems.

#### **Other Requirements of Position**

* Works under broad supervision. Designs and carries out programs and far-reaching objectives independently, informing management as appropriate.
* Major responsibilities require a wide degree of creativity and latitude.
* If an error is made while in this position, it will require some effort to identify and can significantly impact the company financially.
* Frequently communicates with coworkers, customers, company executives, and management.
* Maintain equipment and supplies to avoid waste, damage to areas and equipment, and to prevent accidents.

The duties and responsibilities outlined in this posting are not exhaustive and may evolve based on business needs.

All MacAllister Machinery companies are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer, including Disabled and Veteran applicants.

new_roles.title: Director, Distribution Business Process Engineering
new_roles.description:
***If you are an internal associate, please login to Workday and apply through Jobs Hub.***

**Job Purpose**
---------------

 

The Director of Distribution Business Process Engineering leads the design and implementation of business process workflows to support operational excellence, automation, AI-enabled efficiency, regulatory compliance, and digital modernization across distribution functions. This individual leads a team of Process Engineers to eliminate operational waste, create efficiencies, automate, apply AI where it adds value, and mitigate risk. Additionally, the Director personally owns high-priority process engineering initiatives.

 

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Lead and execute complex assessment and improvement projects to remove waste, reduce costs, and scale workflows, serving as an active contributor (process mapping, analysis, solution design, etc.) in addition to directing the team's work.
* Maintain a hands-on workload of priority initiatives while managing a team of Process Engineers, typically allocating approximately 50–60% of time to individual project delivery and 40–50% to people leadership and strategic partnership.
* Coach, mentor, and direct a team of Process Engineers. Responsible for all personnel actions, including hiring, performance management, development, corrective action, and termination.
* Partner with senior leaders to establish rules, workflow design, and automation priorities and connect business goals with data-driven process solutions.
* Establish and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics for workflow processes and systems to measure impact and ensure efficiency.
* Build and present reports, charts, and summaries to leadership.
* Provide forecasting and other workflow analysis to support the implementation of reengineered workflows.
* Partner with business leaders to implement new and improved business processes and systems.
* Consult with the Training & Development team to develop training materials that support the implementation of reengineered processes.
* Manage the creation, maintenance, and enhancement of business rules.
* Govern process architecture repositories, ensuring all financial workflows are fully documented for internal audit and external regulators.
* Partner with SVP, Distribution Operations to develop and execute the AI strategy for distribution.
Identify, evaluate, and prioritize opportunities to apply AI and intelligent automation to distribution workflows. Lead pilots and implementations in partnership with Technology, Compliance, and business leaders, ensuring appropriate governance, documentation, and risk controls. 

 

**Other Duties**

Performs other duties and/or projects as assigned. 

 

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Proven ability to dissect complex, cross-functional operations into visual, data-driven process maps.
* Strong understanding of process development frameworks to drive user adoption of new processes.
* Strong knowledge of Jackson’s systems and procedures.
* Strong knowledge of engineering principles, including statistics and their applications.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, SharePoint, PowerPoint, and Power BI.
* Strong knowledge of financial services and/or insurance industry business operations.
* Expert knowledge of and/or aptitude to obtain expert knowledge of skills and business rules, which may include proficiency with: Jackson’s administrative systems, products, distributor rules, tax laws, and state and federal regulatory rules.
* Strong organization skills with an ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Proven ability to accept, adapt, and positively influence the implementation of change in an ever-changing environment. Ability to lead change initiatives and communicate in a positive manner.
* Strong collaboration skills with an ability to work effectively with individuals across multiple teams to accomplish objectives.
* Strong business acumen with a demonstrated ability to understand complex business situations and exercise sound judgement.
* Excellent quantitative, analytical, decision making, and problem-solving skills with the ability to think creatively and apply solutions in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to develop staff through coaching, training, and support.
* Ability to balance individual contributor responsibilities with people management duties, shifting between hands-on execution and coaching as team and project needs require.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills with a proven ability to convey complex information in a clear and understandable manner and influence decision making.
* Strong negotiation skills.
Strong relationship management skills, both external and internal of Jackson. 

 

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience required. Major in Engineering or a related stem field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, etc. preferred.
* 5+ years of relevant business process design and/or analytical experience required.
* Prior experience leading or mentoring a team preferred, ideally while remaining a hands-on contributor.
* Project management experience required.
* Insurance or financial services industry experience preferred.

new_roles.description:
**Job Summary**

The Director of Operations leads business operations and operations management, turning strategic plans into clear priorities and effective execution. This role guides senior leadership and executive-level teams, oversees budgets and financial performance, and advances operational excellence through data-driven decisions and process improvement. The Director also supports business development management and leads change across the organization.

**Responsibilities**

* Set strategic direction for operations and align programs and projects with business priorities.
* Lead executive-level team management, supervise managers, and communicate plans and performance clearly with executives.
* Direct budget management, forecasting, financial management, and profit and loss (P&L) analysis; use operational analysis to guide decisions.
* Identify and deliver process improvement and operational excellence initiatives, including large-scale organizational change management.
* Manage business development efforts and coordinate cross-functional programs to strengthen business performance.
* Your impact: By connecting operational analysis with practical process improvements, you help teams work more effectively and support better outcomes for the business and its customers.

**Qualifications**

* 4+ Years of demonstrated leadership, management, and supervising experience in business management, business operations, or operations management.
* Experience in strategic management, strategic planning, project management, program management, and change management.
* Experience managing budgets and financial performance, including executive-level budget management, budgeting, forecasting, and P&L analysis.
* Ability to make data-driven decisions and lead operational analysis and process improvement.
* Strong verbal communication with executives and experience guiding senior leadership or executive-level teams.
* Experience in business development and operational excellence initiatives is preferred.

Pay: Up to $65,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Ogden, UT 84401
