**Description**
**THE COMPANY**
For over 40 years, Aero Simulation, Inc. (ASI) has provided quality flight training devices to the US Military. ASI has successfully built numerous training systems with a primary focus on aircrew and maintenance training systems. Our current programs include, but are not limited to, the B-1 Training Systems (Air Force), E-2D Training Systems (Navy), CH-53E Training Devices (USMC), IMOMS (Coast Guard), Navigation, Seamanship, Shiphandling Trainer – NSST (Navy). To learn more about ASI visit Programs- Aero Simulation, Inc.
  
  
ASI is a 100% employee-owned engineering and manufacturing company committed to supporting the nation’s warfighters. Being 100% employee-owned directly impacts our culture: it drives our decision-making, motivates our teams, increases our productivity, improves retention and contributes to the future success of our company. Our culture is one where we work hard for our clients and for each other – and we have fun collaborating, sharing experience and expertise, and learning along the way. We strive to deliver exceptional quality, elevate client relationships, and enrich the careers and lives of our employee-owners. As Employee-Owners, we are invested in the success and continued development of each other and the company.
  
  
In addition to the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), we offer a flexible work environment, generous paid time off, professional development opportunities, industry competitive compensation, and superior benefits to include medical, dental, 401k and more!
  
  
ASI is a great place to build a career and grow with a company that is dedicated to quality, service and to fostering a community of support for each and every member of the team. To learn more about this opportunity, keep reading!
  
  
**Position Summary**
ASI is seeking an experienced, results-driven Director of Production to provide strategic leadership and operational oversight of its production organization. This is a key senior leadership position responsible for ensuring the successful manufacturing, assembly, integration, and delivery of ASI's advanced simulation and military training device hardware.
  
  
Based in Tampa, Florida, and reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer (COO), the Director of Production will oversee Production Control, Material Control, and Manufacturing through functional managers and department leads. The position will also provide executive oversight of Facility Management and Workplace Safety through the Facilities Manager.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring demonstrated experience leading complex manufacturing operations, developing high-performing teams, managing production capacity and resources, and delivering technical products in demanding, schedule-driven environments.
  
  
This individual will play an important role in supporting ASI's Department of Defense, U.S. military, government agency, and defense industry programs while ensuring the organization is positioned to support new business opportunities and long-term growth.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
*Strategic Leadership & Operational Management*

* Provide strategic direction and operational leadership for Production Control, Material Control, and Manufacturing.
* Establish production priorities, performance expectations, resource requirements, and organizational objectives.
* Lead through functional managers, promoting accountability, operational discipline, and effective execution.
* Ensure production operations consistently meet contractual commitments, customer requirements, program milestones, and delivery schedules.
* Partner with executive leadership to develop operational strategies supporting current programs and future business growth.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure organizational effectiveness and drive improvement.

*Production Planning & Program Execution*

* Oversee production planning, scheduling, capacity management, and resource allocation across multiple concurrent programs.
* Partner with Program Management and Engineering to translate contractual requirements and technical specifications into executable production plans.
* Ensure production readiness, including personnel, materials, equipment, facilities, documentation, and approved manufacturing processes.
* Identify and mitigate production risks that could impact cost, schedule, quality, or customer delivery.
* Support program reviews, production readiness assessments, customer meetings, and government inspections.
* Provide production estimates, labor forecasts, capacity assessments, and schedule inputs for new business proposals.

*Manufacturing & Systems Integration*

* Oversee the manufacturing and assembly of complex simulation and training device hardware.
* Ensure effective collaboration between Production and Engineering to promote manufacturability, reliability, and cost-effective designs.
* Support the integration of major simulation hardware components, including visual display systems, motion platforms, and associated subsystems.
* Ensure manufacturing activities follow approved engineering drawings, Bills of Materials (BOMs), configuration requirements, and engineering change processes.
* Drive improvements in production flow, manufacturing efficiency, product quality, and delivery performance.

*Workforce Leadership & Development*

* Lead, mentor, and develop production managers, supervisors, manufacturing engineers, technicians, assemblers, and integration personnel.
* Establish clear performance expectations and accountability standards for functional managers.
* Develop staffing and workforce plans to support current and anticipated production requirements.
* Identify workforce development needs and implement appropriate training and cross-training initiatives.
* Build organizational depth through succession planning, leadership development, and employee engagement.
* Foster a culture centered on safety, quality, teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

*Materials Management & Supply Chain Coordination*

* Ensure effective coordination between Production and Procurement to maintain material availability and support production schedules.
* Monitor material shortages, supplier performance, inventory levels, and long-lead procurement requirements.
* Establish appropriate material priorities based on program schedules and contractual commitments.
* Ensure effective inventory management, material traceability, and control of customer-furnished and government-furnished property.
* Promote accurate material tracking and accountability through ASI's ERP system.

*Quality & Regulatory Compliance*

* Ensure production operations comply with ASI's ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System and applicable contractual, customer, government, and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Quality Assurance to address nonconformances, corrective actions, root-cause analysis, and process improvements.
* Maintain effective production documentation, inspection records, test results, and configuration records.
* Support government quality audits, customer surveillance activities, and acceptance inspections.
* Promote a culture of quality and adherence to approved manufacturing processes throughout the production organization.

*Budget, Cost Control & Performance*

* Develop and manage production budgets, labor forecasts, and operational resource plans.
* Monitor production costs, labor utilization, productivity, rework, and overhead.
* Identify opportunities to improve manufacturing efficiency, reduce waste, and increase production throughput.
* Evaluate production capacity and capital equipment requirements.
* Provide regular operational and financial performance reporting to the COO and executive leadership.
* Support long-term resource planning and investment strategies aligned with anticipated business growth.

*Facility Management & Workplace Safety*

* Provide executive oversight of Facility Management and Workplace Safety through the Facilities Manager.
* Establish strategic priorities for facility readiness, infrastructure reliability, maintenance, and workplace safety.
* Ensure facilities, equipment, and infrastructure adequately support current production requirements and future growth.
* Review facility performance, safety metrics, significant incidents, and corrective actions.
* Coordinate facility investment, capital requirements, and infrastructure planning with the Facilities Manager and COO.
* Promote a safe, organized, and efficient working environment.

*Continuous Improvement*

* Implement Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, 5S, and other operational excellence methodologies, as appropriate.
* Establish consistent production management practices, standard operating procedures, and performance measures.
* Identify opportunities to reduce cycle times, eliminate waste, improve first-pass yield, and increase productivity.
* Drive corrective and preventive actions to resolve recurring operational issues.
* Promote employee engagement, proactive problem-solving, and continuous

**LEADERSHIP EXPECTATIONS**

* Provides leadership and direct supervision of Group Leaders responsible for Manufacturing, Facility Management, Production Control, Workplace Safety, and Stockroom operations, establishing priorities, expectations, and accountability for operational performance, quality, efficiency, safety, and on-time delivery.
* The Director maintains oversight of these functional areas while ensuring alignment with program requirements and organizational objectives. Ensures teams have the resources, processes, equipment, capabilities, and organizational support necessary to maintain safe and efficient operations, support successful program execution, and meet production schedules and contractual commitments.

**Requirements**
**EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

* 10–15 years of progressive experience in manufacturing, production, or operations management.
* At least 5 years of leadership experience managing production teams, functional managers, and complex manufacturing operations.
* Proven experience overseeing the manufacturing, assembly, integration, and delivery of complex technical products.
* Demonstrated ability to manage production schedules, labor resources, materials, budgets, capacity, and contractual delivery commitments.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production planning, quality management systems, and operational performance metrics.
* Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and drive accountability across multiple functional organizations.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Working knowledge of facility operations, infrastructure, and workplace safety requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in aerospace, defense, aviation, flight simulation, military training systems, or related industries.
* Experience supporting U.S. Department of Defense programs, military customers, or defense prime contractors.
* Experience with complex electromechanical systems and hardware/software integration.
* Familiarity with ISO 9001, Lean Manufacturing, and Six Sigma principles.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems, production planning tools, and manufacturing performance reporting.
* Familiarity with government contracting, DoD Manufacturing Planning (MIL-HDBK-896), configuration management, and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT).
* Experience managing multiple concurrent production programs.
* Experience providing executive oversight of facility management, infrastructure planning, capital equipment, and workplace safety functions.

*Technical and Leadership Competencies*

* Defense manufacturing and production operations.
* Mechanical and electrical assembly and integration.
* Simulation hardware manufacturing and testing.
* Production planning, scheduling, and capacity management.
* Configuration management and engineering change control.
* Quality management systems and regulatory compliance.
* Government contracting and DoD acquisition environments.
* ERP/MRP systems and material requirements planning.
* Cost accounting, labor forecasting, and operational performance metrics.
* Strategic thinking and organizational leadership.
* Cross-functional collaboration and resource allocation.
* Leadership development, team building, and change management.
* Accountability for cost, schedule, quality, and delivery performance.

*Security & Compliance Requirements*

* Must be eligible to work in the United States.
* Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Secret-level security clearance.
* Must successfully complete applicable government security eligibility and investigation requirements.
* Must be able to work in accordance with applicable DoD security, export control, and controlled information requirements.
* Familiarity with International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Export Administration Regulations (EAR), and Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) requirements, as applicable.

**What Success Looks Like**
The Director of Production will be successful by:
  
  

* Delivering production commitments on time and within established cost and quality objectives.
* Building a strong, accountable, and effective production leadership team.
* Maintaining production readiness and sufficient capacity to support current and future programs.
* Improving manufacturing efficiency, productivity, and operational performance.
* Ensuring effective coordination among Production, Engineering, Program Management, Quality, Procurement, and Facilities.
* Maintaining safe, reliable, and growth-ready production facilities.
* Positioning ASI's production organization to successfully execute new program awards and support long-term business growth.

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or a related technic
  
  
al discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

Computer keyboarding, computer monitor and mouse use including reaching forward, grasping, finger and wrist manipulation, and neck bending and turning; near vision is necessary for computer monitor use.

**Position Overview**

As the Director of Manufacturing, you will serve as the senior plant leader for a high-volume beverage canning operation responsible for batching, filling, seaming, and packaging canned CELSIUS® beverages. You will provide strategic and operational leadership across production, quality, food safety, maintenance, engineering, safety, warehousing, workforce development, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on manufacturing leader who has operated in a high-speed, automated food, beverage, packaging, or consumer products environment. Yes

VP of Manufacturing

Full-Time

* **Education:**
  Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Food Science, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience may be considered
* Experience leading high-volume, automated manufacturing operations and managing production, maintenance, engineering, quality, safety, and continuous improvement functions
* Working knowledge of FSSC 22000, ISO 22000 principles, HACCP, GMP, FSMA, food defense, food fraud prevention, traceability, prerequisite programs, CAPA systems, and audit readiness

* Strong analytical, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with plant start-ups, expansions, new line installations, automation, commissioning, scale-up, or major capital investments

* Oversee inspections, testing, product release, holds, deviations, nonconforming product, complaints, CAPAs, and corrective-action effectiveness in partnership with Quality
* Ensure beverage-specific quality controls are effective, including ingredient and batch accuracy, Brix and carbonation targets, fill levels and net contents, double-seam inspection, date/lot coding, and finished-product testing

* Maintain a strong safety culture through employee engagement, training, audits, risk assessments, safety observations, incident investigations, emergency preparedness, and corrective-action plans
* Collaborate with Human Resources to recruit, develop, retain, and engage a high-performing plant workforce
* Build leadership capability through coaching, performance management, individual development plans, skills matrices, cross-training, succession planning, and consistent leader standard work

This role is crucial in ensuring that both manufacturing sites and operations align with the division's strategic direction and receives the appropriate resourcing, in addition to balancing innovation with practical execution to drive the business line's manufacturing operational success.

****Panther: Better Health Is Skin Deep****
Panther is building the leading skin-powered treatment delivery and data platform for health and longevity. Its proprietary intradermal SmartPatch™ precisely delivers treatments to activate local and systemic healing, unlocking the skin as a scalable gateway for care. Panther’s AI-based platform accelerates partners’ product development and personalizes treatment, resulting in compelling consumer and provider experiences. Panther is targeting economically attractive markets of increasing clinical and regulatory difficulty, starting with its PIQUE™ branded Skincare products in mid-2027, and rapidly progressing to Medical Aesthetics and Therapeutics thereafter. Panther’s platform, significant IP portfolio and staged regulatory strategy provide a defensible moat. Panther is led by a team of successful entrepreneurs and operators and is advised by leading scientific experts.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Panther Life Sciences is building a new category of consumer-centric health and beauty products powered by our SmartPatch platform. As we move from development into commercialization, manufacturing becomes the critical unlock for scale, quality, and customer trust.
  
  
We are seeking a Director of Manufacturing Operations to own this transition end-to-end. This role is responsible for translating innovative R&D into reliable, high-quality, and scalable commercial production across both cosmetic and medical device products. You will lead the build-out of Panther's manufacturing strategy, serving as the bridge between internal development teams and external CMO partners.
  
  
You will define how manufacturing operates at Panther, from selecting and standing up partners, to leading technology transfer, to building the systems that allow us to scale from thousands to millions of units. This is not a maintenance role. You will be building the manufacturing function from scratch. Your work will directly impact product availability, customer experience, and the company's ability to grow.
  
  
You will work closely with the leadership team and cross-functional team members in formulation, device development, and quality to establish a manufacturing engine that supports both near-term commercial goals and long-term platform expansion. This is for someone who wants to build, scale, and set the standard for manufacturing in a category-defining company with a great team and a platform that is already generating clinical results. If you want to build something that matters, we want to hear from you.
  
  
Some travel will required approximately 10% -30%
  
  
This role is ideally based in Pittsburgh, with New York as an alternative location."

* Serve as the primary relationship owner and day-to-day point of contact for CMO partners

**Quality, Compliance & Cross-Functional Leadership**

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience scaling a product from R&D to commercial manufacturing in a regulated environment
* Experience overseeing manufacturing operations for a Class II or III medical device or equivalent regulated product
* Hands-on experience scaling production volumes significantly (e.g., 10x or more)
* Direct experience working with CMO partners including selection, onboarding, and tech transfer
* Experience managing supply chain, logistics, inventory, and fulfillment operations
* Familiarity with Quality Management Systems (QMS) in regulated environments
* Demonstrated ability to lead technology transfer and process scale-up
* Experience with manufacturing cost modeling and financial planning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with combination products (drug + device), such as auto-injectors, EpiPens, nasal sprays, or microarray-based systems

**Benefits**

Veranova is a global leader in the development and manufacturing of complex active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) for pharma and biotech customers. With deep technical expertise and impressive flexibility, we develop solutions and processes that support and accelerate innovation.

  

Join us on our mission to enable current and next-generation therapeutics to improve and save the lives of patients.

  

**Role Overview:**

  

The Sr Manager, QA is responsible for leading the Veranova Quality Assurance team, managing quality oversight of the manufacturing process and associated operations. This includes leading and managing multiple QA teams for batch record review, batch disposition, and on the floor QA support to ensure GMP compliance across all stages of manufacturing, as well as disposition and release of starting materials and customer facing Quality program leads for each client. The person filling this role will be responsible for the leadership, development and training of team members within their oversight as well as providing supportive leadership and strategic direction to operate with and maintain compliance to regulatory and industry quality standards. The role is expected to build strong collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders to drive compliance and continuous improvement of GMP operations.

  

The position is 100% on site 1st shift at our Devens, MA facility.

  

**Core Responsibilities:**

  

  
* Evaluate and implement systems, methods, techniques, and solutions to complex quality compliance issues.
  
* Interface with Clients for project planning, and problem resolution with a strong customer service approach.
  
* Lead or support implementation of critical compliance systems and provide recommendations to operations management.
  
* Recommends the stop of any manufacture and/or distribution of a product if necessary.
  
* Manages the review, approval, and ensures delivery of Quality Assurance related training content and programs including new Quality Assurance initiatives for continuous improvement.
  
* Analyzes trends associated with data, proficiency testing, equipment/supply/reagent defects and supports development of solutions as appropriate.
  
* Direct and advise the Quality Assurance group to achieve long and short-term goals and objectives.
  
* Develops, improves, and revises Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Quality Policies as required/needed.
  
* Ensures the review and approval of equipment qualification protocols and results.
  
* Participates in internal auditing programs to assure compliance with regulatory requirements and company standards.
  
* Partner collaboratively with Production, Maintenance, and QC for all Quality decisions within the scope of the role.
  
* Additional assignments/ duties to support team objective and contribute to the Veranova mission may evolve based on business needs.
  

  

**Qualifications:**

  

  
* BS or MS in Chemistry, Engineering or related field required.
  
* Must have a minimum of 10 years of experience in Quality Assurance in an FDA regulated industry. Experience in an API in GMP environment is preferred.
  
* Minimum of 7 years of supervisory experience required; Proven ability to lead and coach, and motivate employees, clearly communicate job requirements, and effectively manage performance of staff.
  
* Must have established experience in Analytical and Quality Control support of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API).
  
* Knowledge and previous experience with GMP, ICH Q7, and 21 CFR Part 11; Expertise in FDA regulations, GMPs, and Quality Systems relevant to pharmaceutical manufacturing.
  
* Experience with hosting and/or regulatory facing inspection responsibilities is required.
  
* Knowledge of Inventory Management, LIMS, Quality Management software systems experience desired.
  
* Must be a change agent and have strong interest in succession planning and professional development of their team(s); Ability to change priorities in response to company demands while continuing to deliver exceptional work quality through leadership by example.
  

  

**Salary Range:**

  

The salary range for this role is $155,000–$175,000. This range represents a good‑faith estimate of the compensation we expect to offer for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. In exceptional cases, compensation may exceed the stated range.

  

All full-time employees are eligible to participate in our annual incentive bonus program. Bonus targets vary by career level and are based on individual and company performance.

  

**Our Commitment:**

* Financial Wellness:
  Veranova is committed to fair and transparent compensation practices. This includes a competitive base salary, eligibility for performance-based bonuses, and an attractive 401(k) Plan with company match. Salary ranges reflect the scope and expectations of the role, and are based on market data, internal equity, and role-specific factors. Final compensation may vary depending on experience, skills, education, and business needs.

* Inclusive Culture:
  At Veranova, an inclusive culture is integral to our values. We welcome people with diverse experiences and perspectives who share our mission to improve and save lives. Even if you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply. Veterans, first responders, and those transitioning from military to civilian life bring valuable skills that strengthen our team.
  

  

**Additional Information:**

  

Applicants for this role must be authorized to work in the United States without further employer sponsorship.

existing_roles.description:
Innovation starts from the heart. Edwards Lifesciences is the leading global structural heart innovation company, driven by a passion to improve patient lives. With millions of patients served in over 100 countries, each team makes a meaningful contribution by improving patient outcomes and discovering lasting solutions for unmet patient needs. Our
**Senior Manager, Quality Engineering**
position is a unique career opportunity that could be your next step towards an exciting future.
  
  
The Senior Manager, Quality Engineering is a people leadership and manufacturing role responsible for providing quality and compliance oversight. This leader will manage and develop a team of Quality Engineers while partnering closely with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Facilities, Maintenance, and Supply Chain to ensure manufacturing activities are performed safely, effectively, and in compliance with applicable quality system requirements.
  
  
The position will oversee quality and compliance activities supporting the plant’s major production areas, including THV manufacturing, TMTT manufacturing, advanced catheters, and metals. The successful candidate will strengthen NCR and CAPA execution, improve investigation quality, monitor operational quality metrics, and establish effective communication and continuity.
  
  
**How You'll Make an Impact:**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Quality Engineers supporting manufacturing operations, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and individual development plans.
* Provide quality and compliance oversight for manufacturing activities, ensuring operations are performed in accordance with approved procedures, quality system requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Oversee the initiation, investigation, review, approval, and timely closure of nonconformance reports, including evaluating investigation quality, root cause determination, corrective actions, and product or process risk.
* Own and provide leadership for CAPAs, including investigation strategy, root cause analysis, action planning, implementation, effectiveness verification, and sustainable closure.
* Lead the deployment, implementation, and continuous improvement of quality management systems and manufacturing quality processes aligned with ISO 13485 and 21 CFR Part 820.
* Review and approve test method validations, measurement system analyses, and manufacturing process validations, including IQ, OQ, and PQ documentation.
* Monitor quality metrics, trends, investigation performance, and quality data reviews; identify emerging risks and provide actionable recommendations to Operations and Quality leadership.
* Support internal and external audits by ensuring operations remain inspection-ready, responding to auditor questions, and leading or supporting actions resulting from audit observations.
* Partner with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Manufacturing, Facilities, Maintenance, and Supply Chain to resolve quality issues, maintain compliant production, and strengthen operational controls.
* Establish effective shift-to-shift communication and escalation processes to ensure timely transfer of quality, production, and compliance information.
* Provide quality leadership for supplier-related issues, as applicable, including investigation support, corrective actions, and supplier performance concerns.
* Promote a culture of quality, accountability, continuous improvement, and proactive risk management.
* Develop and implement quality processes that improve product compliance, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Other incidental duties as assigned.

**What You'll Need (Required):**

* Bachelor’s degree with relevant Quality Engineering, Quality Management, or Manufacturing Quality experience within a highly regulated environment; or equivalent experience based on Edwards’ criteria.
* Demonstrated people leadership experience managing and developing engineers or other technical quality professionals.
* Experience deploying, implementing, or sustaining quality management systems within a regulated manufacturing environment, including working knowledge of ISO 13485 and 21 CFR Part 820 requirements.
* Strong experience leading CAPAs, nonconformance investigations, and structured root cause analysis, including evaluation of investigation quality and effectiveness.

**What Else We Look For (Preferred):**

* Engineering or Scientific degree
* Medical device manufacturing experience
* Experience providing quality oversight for manufacturing or production operations, including partnering directly with Operations and Engineering to resolve compliance and product quality issues.
* Demonstrated ability to interpret quality data, monitor operational quality metrics, recognize adverse trends, and escalate significant risks.
* Experience with microbiology principles or microbiological controls in a regulated manufacturing environment.
* Experience supporting cleanroom qualification, environmental controls, or manufacturing operations performed within controlled environments.
* Supplier quality or supplier management experience, including supplier investigations and corrective actions.
* Experience reviewing or approving test method validations and measurement system analysis studies.
* Experience reviewing or approving manufacturing process validations, including IQ/OQ/PQ.
* Experience supporting internal, external, or regulatory audits.
* Experience leading quality activities across multiple manufacturing technologies, product lines, or production areas.
* Knowledge of statistical methods, process capability, measurement systems, risk management, and continuous improvement tools.
* Demonstrated success strengthening team capability, improving organizational effectiveness, and leading change within a manufacturing quality organization.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence decisions and communicate effectively across technical, operational, and leadership audiences.

At Beckman Coulter Life Sciences, we know time is the most critical facet in the laboratory today:  time to get life-saving therapies to patients faster; reclaiming time by automating tedious manual workflows; and saving time spent addressing erroneous or complex results.
  
  
We are partners in time and accelerate answers to critical questions through the power of automation. We develop innovations for scientists by scientists, with many of our 3,300+ global colleagues coming from the laboratory.

The
**Senior Manager - Global New Product Introduction (NPI)**
- Systems Hardware is responsible for leading Manufacturing Engineering and Operations readiness for hardware- and systems-based product development programs across Beckman Coulter Life Sciences' global manufacturing network. This leader serves as the critical bridge between R&D, Product Management, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Service, and Manufacturing Operations to ensure successful design transfer, manufacturing scale-up, and on-time commercialization of complex life science instrumentation.
  
  
This position reports to the Director, Manufacturing Engineering and is part of the Global Manufacturing Engineering & Innovation organization located in Indianapolis, Indiana. This will be an on-site role with global collaboration across U.S., China, and Europe BEC LS manufacturing and development locations as required.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To**

* Lead Manufacturing Engineering engagement from product concept through commercialization for hardware and instrument platforms, ensuring safety, quality, delivery, cost, supply continuity, reliability, capacity, and launch objectives are achieved.
* Lead governance for the global hardware NPI portfolio, including milestones, resource prioritization, capital plans, risk management, escalation paths, launch metrics, executive reviews, and post-launch stabilization.
* Partner with the Director, Manufacturing Engineering to develop and deploy global NPI and manufacturing engineering strategies aligned with business growth, product roadmaps, manufacturing footprint, capacity, lifecycle, and innovation priorities.
* Ensure robust design transfer and manufacturing readiness across U.S., China, and Europe locations, including manufacturing requirements, process development, equipment and tooling, pilot builds, test methods, documentation, process validation, production ramp, and issue closure.
* Drive Design for Manufacturing, Assembly, Test, Service, Reliability, and Cost in partnership with R&D and other functions, using the Danaher Business System, standard work, visual management, value stream mapping, daily management, kaizen, and structured problem solving.
* Lead selected global manufacturing excellence initiatives involving engineering standards, process capability, automation, digital manufacturing, manufacturing technology, test strategy, productivity, value engineering, and continuous cost improvement.
* Lead and develop managers, engineers, and technical project leaders across a global matrix; strengthen accountability, technical capability, talent reviews, succession planning, leadership development, inclusion, and mobility across global and site teams.

**The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Biomedical, Electrical, Manufacturing, Systems, or a closely related engineering discipline.
* Typically 10+ years of progressive experience across engineering, manufacturing, operations, product development, and/or new product introduction.

Working knowledge of FDA, ISO, quality-system, design-control, risk-management, verification and validation, change-control, traceability, process-validation, and product-lifecycle requirements.
* Demonstrated success launching complex electromechanical, software-enabled, diagnostic, medical device, or life science instrumentation products in regulated manufacturing environments.
* Deep experience with design transfer, industrialization, manufacturing readiness, process development and validation, manufacturing test, tooling and equipment, supplier readiness, ramp, and lifecycle support.
* Proven ability to translate business and product strategy into engineering priorities, operating mechanisms, investment recommendations, and measurable results. Experience leading portfolio governance, resource prioritization, capital planning, risk reviews, and cross-functional executive decision-making.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* Master’s degree in engineering, an MBA, PMP certification, Lean Six Sigma certification, or comparable advanced development.
* Experience with flow cytometry, centrifugation, liquid handling, particle characterization, genomics, bioprocessing, or comparable scientific instrumentation platforms.
* Experience leading global engineering transformation, automation, digital manufacturing, connected equipment, manufacturing data systems, or advanced analytics initiatives.
* Experience with site transfers, localization, manufacturing footprint changes, contract manufacturers, supplier development, acquisition integration, or rapid capacity expansion.

**About Us**
Spellman High Voltage Electronics Corporation, a family owned business for over 75 years, takes pride in powering progress in health, security and quality of life. We are key partners with the world’s leading medical devices, semiconductor, scientific analytics and industrial systems manufacturers. When they want to push the limits of what’s possible with high voltage applications, they turn to us to make it happen.
  
  
While Spellman is not a household name, our products are used to make and often power many of the most advanced technologies that make modern life possible. With design and manufacturing sites in North America, Europe and Asia, we have become the preferred provider of high voltage power solutions for OEMs pushing the boundaries of technology around the world by designing and producing the products they need to power progress.
  
  
The primary role of the Senior Manager, NPI will provide leadership to a diverse team of engineers and provide support in the design, documentation, analysis, and coordination of release for products being transferred from design to production. The Senior Manager, NPI will contribute to the success of projects as well as the team. In this role, the Senior Manager, NPI will balance the work within the team, coach the team through technical challenges, and act as a role model in the organization. The Senior Manager, NPI will be expected to provide technical input to the leadership team to support business decisions.
  
  
This leader, with their team develops and implements operations requirements for design transfer across all product portfolios and collaborates with development, manufacturing and technical support teams to assure that all aspects of design for quality and manufacturability (DQM) are utilized for robust design development, transfer and ultimately scale up. Assures appropriate test method validations and product specifications are developed and implemented. Individual is also responsible for managing new part number creation and appropriate work instruction development. Will work cross functionally to ensure repeatability and reproducibility of the manufactured products within product and process capabilities and meeting of desired specifications.
  
  
Provides leadership of design transfer activities of products also engages in technology transfer activities involving product end of life or transfer to other Spellman High Voltage Electronics manufacturing sites.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Establishes overall team direction and goals, and sets direction of resources toward completion of goals, in conjunction with Senior Leadership in both Development and Operations. Promotes an open, collaborative environment focused on teamwork
* Establishes and maintains design transfer project milestones and timelines
* Supports robust design specification development and validation activities during design transfer, working closely with counterparts in the development team.
* Oversight for all NPI deliverables to the customer and expected team output
* Communication with all members of the NPI team to monitor project status, scope changes, and KPIs
* Work with the Product Development teams to ensure that all new products have been put through the adequate testing and best practices have been used
* Work collaboratively with peers and other cross-functional team members including define sub-system design requirement specifications and design architectures
* Manage and collaborate across multi-technical disciplines and cross-functional teams
* Plan, manage, and delegate project resource requirements, schedules, and task activities.
* Resolve problems using solutions that involve new techniques, technologies, or concepts.
* Effective application of engineering excellence processes and techniques (DFMEA, PFMEA, DOE, DVP&R, boundary diagrams, DFM/A, Technical Design Reviews, fault tree and risk assessment, SCRUM, etc.)
* Lead a team of NPI Manufacturing Engineers, in collaboration with other organizations, to support production of complex products with responsibilities including but not limited to:
* Establish group and individual objectives, priorities, and metrics
* Ensure production of products meets expected output
* Ensure quality requirements are fulfilled and maintained
* Provide technical support for failure analysis and root cause investigation of product failures.
* Analyze manufacturing lines from a risk perspective (pFMEA) to incorporate and validate critical tests used in manufacturing.
* Assume responsibility for the validation of manufacturing equipment and processes leveraging standard qualification approaches (IQ/OQ/PQ/DQ/PPQ).
* Provide production line support for day-to-day engineering issues on production and NPI lines.
* Identify and implement continuous improvement projects with respect to first pass yield, cycle time reduction, product reliability, capacity enhancements, and cost reduction.
* Liaise between project management, engineering, and manufacturing functions to ensure project goals are on track
* Adherence to applicable QMS policies and procedures
* Ensure the team sets and meets reasonable deliverable expectations Review and approve engineering changes
* Facilitate problem-solving efforts and continually improve processes
* Understand, lead, and coach in DFX concepts, pFMEA, problem-solving, and transfer efforts
* Lead in the decision-making process for production planning and layout
* Evaluate and estimate the required and proposed engineering tasks (headcount or hours) Understand the product funnel and needs for NPI resources during the early phases of development
* Other duties as assigned by management

**Requirements**

* Minimum of 15 years of demonstrated experience in people management and leadership role
* Minimum of 10 years experience in electronics manufacturing and knowledge of Design Control guidelines
* Minimum of 10 years leading/managing New Product Introduction Teams; including hiring, employee development, managing subordinate managers, project planning, and coordination in a matrixed organization
* Strong Conflict resolution and negotiation skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent time management, planning, organization and problem solving skills
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor and coach team members
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills to interact effectively with all levels of the organization as well as directly with key customer contacts
* Must be very good with materials, mechanical parts and electronic components logistics, planning, well organized and resourceful;
* Must be able to multitask in an environment requirement a high level of detail and accuracy, work independently with guidance and take ownership of all assigned tasks;
* Capable of presenting information to management team and influencing key stakeholders;
* Ability to relentlessly track and follow-up on open issues and action items;
* Prior responsibility for validation of processes, equipment, and products.
* Experience in an ISO 13485, ISO 9001, or medical device manufacturing environment preferred.
* A clear understanding of BOM, BOM structure, ECO process, and materials/product setup

existing_roles.description:
**About Komline**

As a pioneering leader in advanced separation technologies, Komline has established a global reputation for engineering excellence. Through our combination of innovative design, cutting-edge manufacturing capabilities, and decades of industry experience, we consistently deliver the highest quality equipment from our integrated manufacturing facilities. Serving our core markets of Water & Process, Agricultural & Renewables, and Industrials, we pride ourselves on providing comprehensive separation solutions precisely tailored to our clients' requirements. With a strong track record of strategic growth and acquisitions, Komline continues to expand its solution portfolio and technical capabilities while maintaining our commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction.

**This Opportunity**

The Director, Operational Excellence is responsible for building, deploying, and sustaining the Komline Business System (KBS), a consistent operating excellence system across all Komline sites. This leader will partner with Business Unit General Managers, Plant Managers, and functional leaders to improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, working capital, productivity, and overall operating discipline while respecting the P&L accountability of each business. The role will lead Komline’s enterprise continuous improvement (CI) capability, develop CI talent, and ensure proven practices are shared and scaled across the network.

The successful candidate is a hands-on manufacturing leader who combines strong Lean expertise with business judgment, credibility on the shop floor, and the executive presence to influence decentralized business leaders. This leader will be equally comfortable coaching a plant team, challenging a site improvement plan, and communicating enterprise priorities to senior leadership.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this enterprise-wide role supports all Komline operating sites.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Develop and lead implementation of the KBS Operational Excellence strategy, roadmap, standards, and multi-year improvement agenda across all sites
* Lead, coach, and develop the CI Manager team and other improvement resources; establish clear site coverage, priorities, and deployment expectations
* Partner with GMs and Plant Managers to identify the highest-impact opportunities and build robust, financially validated site-level improvement pipelines that deliver sustained results in safety, productivity, delivery, lead time, quality, inventory, cost, and working capital
* Establish and sustain common Lean / KBS operating practices, including daily management, visual management, standard work, problem solving, RCCM, value-stream improvement, kaizen, and leader standard work
* Create a practical maturity assessment for Operational Excellence and use it to prioritize coaching, capability building, and site support; track improvements in maturity and consistent adoption of core operating practices
* Drive measurable productivity and capacity improvements through flow, labor optimization, constraint removal, setup reduction, layout improvement, and waste elimination
* Partner with Industrial Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, EHS, Finance, Engineering, HR, and other enterprise functions to quantify benefits and ensure improvements are sustained
* Build CI capability within site leadership and frontline teams through training, coaching, kaizen leadership, and development of local change agents
* Establish common operational KPI definitions and review routines that enable benchmarking and the sharing and scaling of best practices across Komline
* Support acquisition integration by assessing operational maturity, identifying improvement opportunities, and integrating acquired sites into Komline’s operating system
* Provide regular enterprise-level reporting to the COO on CI pipeline, benefits realization, site maturity, risks, and resource priorities
* Promote a culture of accountability, structured problem solving, and continuous improvement while maintaining strong partnership with decentralized business leadership

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field
* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing operations, continuous improvement, operational excellence, industrial engineering, or related leadership roles
* Demonstrated success leading Lean / continuous improvement across multiple sites or business units
* Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing, daily management, kaizen, standard work, value-stream mapping, structured problem solving, and performance management
* Proven ability to influence GMs, Plant Managers, and functional leaders without relying on direct authority
* Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to translate operational improvements into measurable financial impact
* Excellent leadership, coaching, facilitation, communication, and executive presentation skills
* Ability to travel approximately 50%+, depending on site and project needs

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Lean leadership certification or equivalent and/or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt
* Experience in multi-site industrial, engineered-product, capital-equipment, or process-equipment manufacturing
* Experience integrating acquired businesses or deploying a common operating system across decentralized businesses
* Experience with plant layout, flow optimization, capacity improvement, and working-capital initiatives
* MBA or advanced technical/operations degree

**Equal Opportunity Statement:**
Komline is an EEO employer – M/F/Vets/Disabled

Lead the development and execution of the organization's Continuous Improvement strategy across manufacturing operations. Drive a culture of Operational Excellence through Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma methodologies, waste elimination, process standardization, employee engagement, and data-driven decision making. **Responsibilities**

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business Administration, or related field.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt Certification.

* Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.

The Director of ICF & Quality Enhancement is responsible for all activities pertaining to the program’s licensure, human rights, personnel, and contract management obligations for the Fort Lauderdale campus. The Director of ICF & Quality Enhancement will evaluate ASC programs/services, including, but not limited to, the development, implementation, data collection, and analysis of program/services, as well as developing staff training programs, to ensure a standard of quality that serves the organization’s mission to improve the lives of persons supported in compliance with federal, state, and local regulations including licensing requirements which include nursing and nutrition.

* Develops a monitoring schedule for both campuses with flexibility to provide immediate assistance as requested
* Ensure that the facilities are maintained in compliance with expected standards for the safety and welfare of the residents.

***C. Agency Leadership & Supervisory Duties***

* Establishes and maintains a leadership role within the Agency through implementation of the Annual Plan and timely response to issues and problems and facilitation of crisis circumstances.
* Consults with program leaders regarding the development and/or implementation of Agency Programs and Best Practices; Reviews and updates program-related best practices on an annual basis.

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Director of Quality and Accreditation to lead our facility’s efforts in ensuring the highest standards of patient care and safety. This leadership role is responsible for overseeing regulatory compliance, quality assurance programs, and continuous improvement initiatives across all clinical and operational areas. The Director will guide the development and implementation of quality protocols, manage accreditation processes, and lead the Quality Assurance and Process Improvement (QAPI) program. The ideal candidate will be a proactive, strategic thinker with a strong commitment to achieving excellence in care delivery and regulatory readiness.

**PURPOSE STATEMENT:**

The Director of Quality and Accreditation is responsible for ensuring patient safety and superior quality of care as measured by survey readiness, treatment program fidelity, and compliance with state and federal laws and regulations and accreditation standards. As such, the Director is responsible for leading and overseeing all aspects of policy development; comprehensive implementation of Acadia’s prescribed clinical protocols, operational quality oversight standards, and programmatic expectations; critical incident reporting; regulatory engagement, including development and submission of plans of correction; certification achievement and maintenance; oversight of the quality assurance and process improvement (QAPI) program; and on-going regulatory readiness strategies at the facility. Through routine physical presence in patient care areas, data analysis and documentation monitoring, and intentional sharing of deep subject-matter expertise, the Director will ensure a proactive, multidisciplinary focus on quality and excellence within the facility.

Responsibilities:

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Lead and monitor day-to-day regulatory readiness, patient safety, and service excellence across the facility.
* QAPI program oversight and management – follow and develop processes for identification, collection, and analysis of quality performance data.
  + Utilize collected data regarding the outcome of activities for delivering continuously improving services.
  + Conduct annual preparation and evaluation of the facility QAPI Program.
  + Complete process improvement projects and incorporate the results into patient care improvements.
  + Submit quality scorecard data to Acadia corporate office as requested.
  + Coordinate the abstraction of clinical data according to Joint Commission specifications and data entry via vendor database for Inpatient Psychiatric Core Measures (ex. national quality measures such as HBIPS).
  + Identify key aspects of care relevant indicators and evaluation of data using formal and informal feedback from consumers of services and other collateral sources is aggregated and used to improve management strategies and service delivery practices.
  + Lead/coordinate data collection and analysis from all departments within the facility.
  + Prepare and present program data trends and action plans to the monthly Quality Council and quarterly to the Medical Executive Committee and the Governing Board.
* Regulatory preparedness – implement sustainable survey preparation and ongoing monitoring processes, including facility-wide auditing and early-issue identification, to maximize achievement of zero- or standard-level survey outcomes.
  + Facility-wide support – collaborate with other departments to sustainably implement best-practices in regulatory/accreditation compliance as evidenced by measurable results with regard to survey outcomes, patient safety metrics, patient experience results, HBIPS, etc.
  + Develop and maintain proficiency in regulatory planning strategy for all standards for all relevant regulatory and accrediting bodies at the local, state, and federal level.
  + Develop and maintain proficiency in the functionality and auditing within electronic platforms such as electronic patient observations and the electronic medical record, as applicable.
  + Lead Root-Cause Analyses and conduct timely and regular evaluation of serious incidents, complaints, grievances and related investigations to:
    - Identification of events, trends and patterns that may affect client health, safety and or treatment efficacy,
    - Committee evaluation findings and recommendations submitted to agency management for corrective action,
    - Implemented actions, outcomes, trends analyzed over time
  + Develop corrective action plans for the resolution of areas of regulatory vulnerability or those which could compromise patient safety in collaboration with other facility leaders.
  + Ensure proper reporting of violations or potential violations to duly authorized enforcement agencies as appropriate and/or required.
  + Ensure proper reporting of incidents and adverse clinical outcomes to duly authorized enforcement agencies or regulatory agencies as appropriate and/or required.
  + In conjunction with assigned corporate Division Quality Director, initiate and lead communications with regulatory agencies as appropriate.
  + Develop sustainable performance improvement practices through analysis of data and prioritization of efforts to improve survey readiness and consistency of care delivery using expected best-practices.
  + Ensure multidisciplinary ownership of best-practices in self-monitoring, auditing, and process improvement, escalating opportunities for improved engagement to the facility CEO as appropriate.
  + Ensures strategic and operational implementation of regulatory requirements, guidelines, and standards of federal, state, and local licensing agencies, accrediting and certifying organizations.
  + Collaborates with Division and Corporate entities and external parties to ensure strategic quality and patient safety initiatives are fully executed at the facility level. Facilitates effective communication with facility and division leadership regarding key clinical performance improvement activities and initiatives.
  + Serves as a technical advisor, educator and internal consultant to all hospital management, staff, and physicians on the use of performance improvement tools and techniques, analytical techniques, and statistical applications.
  + Ensure facility compliance with policies and applicable standards as required by regulatory/accrediting bodies.
  + Facility leader and subject matter expert on high reliability principles and strategies to achieve zero harm.

* Clinical program excellence – assess fidelity and identify root-causes for gaps/lapses in fidelity to Acadia standards. Support other departments in developing and implementing remediation and improvement plans to achieve fidelity to Acadia’s expected practices, including all elements of treatment program implementation.
* + Develop, review, and educate on internal clinical procedures and appropriate use of outcome evaluation tools and the associated results – including patient experience data and other quality scorecard metrics – to ensure continuous quality improvement and ongoing compliance with federal, state, and third-party regulatory requirements.
  + Translate standards, requirements, and policies into terms or processes meaningful to the facility.
* Leadership – serve as a visible, engaged, and dynamic member of the facility leadership team.
  + Chairs the monthly Quality Council
  + Complete safety rounds, participate in leadership rounding, and submit results/corrective actions to Acadia corporate office.
  + Review incident/safety concerns with the leadership team to identify systemic issues and facilitate the development of corrective actions.
  + Lead and facilitate Root Cause Analyses into all serious and/or sentinel events.
  + Invest in the facility staff through engagement in hiring, development, training, performance management, and communication to ensure effective and efficient operations.
  + Oversees the Culture of Safety Survey and follow-up action planning and sustainment processes.
  + Identification of problems or potential problems to prevent risks to patients and staff. Proposes corrective steps that may include, but are not limited to:
    - Changes in policies/procedures,
    - Staffing and assignment changes,
    - Additional education or training for staff,
    - Addition or deletion of services

**OTHER FUNCTIONS:**

* Perform other functions and tasks as assigned.

Qualifications:

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE/SKILL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Human Services or nursing required. Master’s degree in behavioral health/risk discipline, Registered Nurse preferred.
* Two or more years of experience in a Quality, Clinical, or PI role required.
* One or more years of management experience preferred.
* Experience with CARF, DEA, Joint Commission, or CMS surveys, as required by service line(s) supported

**LICENSES/DESIGNATIONS/CERTIFICATIONS:**

* Current licensure appropriate for the degree held required.
* CPR and de-escalation/restraint certification required (training available upon hire and offered by facility).
* First aid may be required based on state or facility.

Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the**Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award**, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

At Crème de la Crème, learning comes alive like nowhere else. Our centers are places that never stand still because kids never do. And when you join us, you’ll become part of that magic—making a memorable impact on young learners and their families every day. In our wow-worthy world of learning, your talents will be the catalyst for creating child care experiences you've never imagined. You’ll link arms with other exceptional humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do—and you’ll know that your work matters.

* As the Crème School Director of Education and Quality, you will  
  + Lead and develop teachers to ensure curriculum alignment with best practices, state standards, and the individual needs of children.
  + Facilitate training and implementation of our comprehensive and developmentally appropriate curriculum for early childhood education.
  + Provide transformative leadership in the field of early childhood education, staying informed about current trends, research, and best practices.
  + Develop a culture of continuous learning and professional development while leading the teaching staff.
  + Establish and maintain high-quality standards for early childhood education program
  + Conduct regular assessments, evaluations, and audits to ensure compliance with Crème standards and licensing requirements
  + Provide guidance and support to teaching staff, promoting a positive and collaborative work environment. In partnership with the Executive Director, host professional development programs to enhance educators' skills and knowledge.
  + Cultivate positive relationships with teachers and parents, involving them in their child's education and development.
  + Collaborate with the community to enhance the educational experience and promote your school within the community.
  + Assist as needed in daily school operations, at times including direct supervision of children
  + Apply data-driven insights to assess program effectiveness, implement strategies to address identified areas of improvement, fostering a culture of continuous quality enhancement.
* Qualifications:
* + Bachelor’s degree in early childhood education, Education Administration, or a related field. (preferred)
  + Meet state specific credentials / guidelines for the role
  + At least one year leadership experience in early childhood education or a related field
  + Proven understanding of early childhood development, educational best practices, and program administration.
  + Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  + Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and multi-task and handle multiple situations optimally.
  + Proven ability to build and sustain positive relationships with diverse staff, families, and community. Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in education.
  + Physically able to use a computer with basic proficiency, lift a minimum of 40pounds, and work indoors or outdoors.
  + Able to assume postures in low levels to allow physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity.
  + Read, write, understand, and speak English to connect with children and their parents in English.

Range of pay $34,216.00 - $80,000.00 Salary

**Our benefits meet you where you are.** We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life:  

* Know your whole family is supported with **discounted child care** benefits.

* Breathe easy with **medical, dental, and vision** benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
* Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with **employee assistance programs.**
* Feel great and thrive with access to **health and wellness programs, paid time off** and **discounts** for work necessities, such as cell phones.
* … and much more.

  
.

We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.

*KinderCare Learning Companies is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.*

existing_roles.description:
Direct Biologics is a market leading innovator and science-based cGMP manufacturer of regenerative biologic products. Direct Biologics is hiring a hands-on QC leader for our Poway, CA testing laboratory in the greater San Diego area. You will lead a team of analysts to execute release and stability testing for a late-stage extracellular vesicle biologics program as part of a broader multi-product pipeline, and prepare the QC function for commercial operations.

We are currently looking for a Director of QC, responsible for:

* Responsible for strategy and execution of late-stage to commercial cGMP testing laboratory readiness, owning key decisions in method transfer, validation, and life-cycle management.
* Drives phase-appropriate regulatory and compliance initiatives for a portfolio of cell therapy extracellular vesicle products (early clinical through commercial stages). Presents plans to senior leadership and leads QC workstream for inspection readiness.
* Leads interactions with health authorities related to internal and outsource testing programs, including in-process, characterization, drug substance and drug product release, and stability.
* This working leadership position requires hands-on participation in routine and non-routine testing activities. The individual must maintain their own training and qualification, work independently at the laboratory bench, execute test methods, troubleshoot problems, perform investigations, and write reports when needed to meet business and regulatory commitments.
* Collaborates with R&D and Analytical Development team to introduce method lifecycle improvements and new technologies to the QC laboratory.
* Accountable for timely execution and documentation of routine laboratory tests. Ensures the on-time closure of sampling plans, protocols, laboratory investigations, CAPAs, change control records, and other QMS commitments.
* Develops and communicates departmental resourcing plans to serve broad company goals, including personnel, budget, and timelines. Adjusts plans and priorities according to executive leadership resourcing decisions.
* Leads Quality Control operations:
* + Hire, onboard, train, qualify, and assist professional development of QC team members.
* + Ensure timely execution of STAT and release testing.
* + Manage stability sample inventory and pull schedule, coordinating sample transit with cGMP warehouse, outsource sample submission, and timely internal testing.
* + Ensure timely purchase and qualification of supplies, materials, and equipment.
* + Maintain equipment use, calibration, maintenance, and cleaning records and coordinate related activities.
* + Communicate testing timeframes, expected start/finish dates, and testing outcomes to internal and external stakeholders.
* + Author/approve policies, procedures, and work instructions for accuracy and compliance.
* + Author/approve ROA, COA, trend reports, and stability reports.
* Responsible for QC data/records to ensure content adheres to established cGMP quality standards.
* + Maintain risk register, support internal and mock audits, and show steady compliance progress in collaboration with QA team members.
* + Collaborate with IT to ensure data Integrity and storage of original source data in accordance with part 11 requirements.
* Ensure strict adherence to EPA, OSHA, and FAA safety and clean environmental guidelines.
* Occasional travel by air and/or car may be required to participate in on-site vendor activities, such as method transfer, vendor meetings, and vendor quality audits.
* Excels in a fast-paced environment. Independently prioritizes activity based on importance and urgency, manages time well, anticipates challenges, and delivers progress in line with program goals.
* Strong attention to detail and related understanding of CFR, compendial, and other regulatory requirements.

  
  
**Requirements**

**Skill Requirements:**

* Top expert in preparing cGMP clinical stage testing laboratories for commercial launch, with evidence of leading a QC readiness workstream for a late-stage or commercial biologic product.
* Extensive knowledge of domestic and global compliance requirements for commercial release testing programs.
* Recent hands-on experience with one or more of the following: human cell culture techniques, cell-based potency assays, protein assays (plate based ELISAs, immunostaining-based assays, fluorescence microscopy), quantitative PCR, RNA and protein isolation and quantification methods.
* Familiarity with cGMP Quality Control testing, qualification, and validation of analytical test methods with internal and outsourced contexts.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in cross-functional team setting.
* Must be highly flexible to respond to urgent needs and directional changes in a start-up environment but also have the attention to detail required to execute studies that will be reviewed by the FDA and other regulatory authorities.
* Lead GMP QC investigations and provide solutions to issues including OOS, deviations and/or CAPA.
* Ability to maintain lab equipment including qualification and calibration.
* Knowledgeable about statistical modeling for quality control applications.
* Technical understanding and working knowledge of contemporary molecular biology, cell biology, microbiology and/or biochemistry.
* Track record leading efficient and cost-effective QC operations while maintaining scientific rigor and GMP compliance. Demonstrated ability to optimize resources, streamline processes, and overcome challenges in a lean operating model.

**Qualifications Requirements:**

* Advanced degree in analytical chemistry, biotechnology, cell and molecular biology, biochemistry, or other related field is preferred.
* Minimum of 8 years biotech based-work experience in cell culture, biochemical, or molecular biology GMP QC testing. Experience with late-stage advanced therapy products is preferred.
* Prior experience with cGMP release testing of drug products is required.
* Prior experience managing and developing GMP laboratory staff, leading investigations, and overseeing outsourced testing is required.
* Past experience interacting with health authorities during laboratory inspections.

  
**Benefits**  

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
* Company 401k match up to 4%
* Paid Time Off (Vacation & Sick)
* Holidays
* Stock Option

This leader partners with enterprise functions and operational stakeholders to document, standardize, and scale quality-of-service delivery across current and future APS sites. To design, implement, and sustain a comprehensive quality management system that enhances efficiency, performance, and consistency across APS services while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, APS Operating System, ABM standards, and client commitments.
